profiles.name: Quick scan
profiles.description: Top 100 ports with -T4 timing — a sensible first look at any host.

profiles.name: Ping sweep
profiles.description: Discover live hosts on a subnet without scanning ports. Great for mapping a /24.

profiles.name: Service & version detection
profiles.description: TCP Connect scan plus -sV — what's running and which version. No root required.

profiles.name: Intense scan
profiles.description: Aggressive: SYN + service + OS + default scripts + traceroute. Loud — needs sudo.

profiles.name: Vuln scan (vulners)
profiles.description: Service detection plus the vulners script — quick CVE lookup based on detected versions.

profiles.name: TLS audit
profiles.description: Certificate + cipher enumeration on TLS-bearing ports. Good for compliance checks.

profiles.name: All TCP ports
profiles.description: Scan every TCP port (1-65535). Slow — best on a single host you really care about.
